name: Kadath
description: Personal strategic HQ: Next.js web + Node API + Postgres, running as the kadath-live Docker Compose stack.

migration.rollback: Stateful rollback requires reviewed target-write reconciliation. Keep the stopped /home/oreo/kadath source and original named volume fenced until that review is complete.
notes: Compose project kadath-live is preserved in personal-sandbox.
Web, API, and PostgreSQL have no host-published ports.
Tailnet-only HTTPS port 8443 proxies to a root-owned Unix socket.
PostgreSQL role, database, logical contents, and TCP-auth posture passed final restore validation.

requirements: Kadath owns backup execution; Argus records and validates the operator contract but does not expose a dashboard backup action.
The server timer retains 14 daily dumps and 8 weekly snapshots; every dump has a checksum and must pass an isolated restore drill.

notes: Handles personal life, work, relationship, and risk data per the project README.
Web and API bind to 127.0.0.1 only; Tailscale Serve terminates tailnet-only HTTPS on port 8443.
Postgres is not published on a host port in the kadath-live Compose stack.
